_what: The laptop filter's whole behaviour (Filter 1.6.3 and later), as data. Signed on the mini PC (the admin panel's Publish config, or node sign-config.mjs in the held laptop-filter folder) and fetched by the extension every 5 minutes from the mini PC and from this repo; no change here needs a new extension or a Chrome Web Store review. Every feature is named in filter/shared/filter-features.js. This default is what Joe asked for (vault AI/Notes 'Laptop filter, what he asked for and what we added, 2026-11-17'): everything agents added without his asking is off here, not deleted from the engine. The suggestive-picture and revealing-clothing removal are locked (locked memory entries 23 to 28, 46): turning them off or narrowing them needs a decisions entry.
note: Default config, 2026-11-17: only what Joe asked for.

pictures.hold._why: Kept on: it is how the locked removal works (a picture is never seen before it is judged). Off shows pictures while they are judged.

pictures.unjudgedHidden._why: Kept on with pictures.hold: a picture never judged is never shown.

youtube._why: Off until Joe turns it on (2026-11-17: 'I eventually want *some* of youtube in there'). YouTube is also kept out of the extension by the laptop's policy for now.

youtube._what: Joe's spec, 2026-11-17: sexual content only, from titles, channel names, descriptions, captions or transcripts and thumbnails; never true crime, violence or adult topics; never stops or removes a video he clicked to play. Any key of YouTubeRules.DEFAULTS (filter/shared/youtube-filter.js) can be set here.
